question: Consider the following statements: Statement-I: The set of all solution of the linear inequalities 3x + 8 < 17 and 2x + 8 ≥ 12 are x < 3 and x ≥ 2 respectively. Statement-II: The common set of solution of linear inequalities 3x + 8 < 17 and 2x + 8 ≥ 12 is (2,3). Which of the following is true?

options.A: Statement-I is false but Statement-II is true
options.D: Statement-I is true but Statement-II is false

correctAnswerText: Statement-I is true but Statement-II is false
explanation: Statement-I: 3x+8<17 → 3x<9 → x<3 ✓. 2x+8≥12 → 2x≥4 → x≥2 ✓. Both parts correct. Statement-II: Common solution is [2,3) not (2,3) since x=2 satisfies both inequalities. Hence Statement-I is true but Statement-II is false.
